title: LexiBuildResult
description: result.json uploaded as the programme-result run artifact by programme-build.yml. The structured replacement for scraping a result marker out of the run log.

workdir.description: Repository-relative directory this run built, echoed from the workdir dispatch input. ABSENT for a root build — every single-app repo — so existing consumers see no change. Present when one repo holds several apps (for example web/ and mobile/), where the result would otherwise not say which app it built. Normalised by the workflow: no leading or trailing slash, no '..'.
